notes.title: KING PONG v0.20
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Setting up a good/bad/perfect system
[*] Modification of special strikes (see below)
[*] Adding the FailBall
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]

The game's special strikes have been modified to accommodate the new combo system.
From now on, you have to hit the ball with a precise timing in order to get a critical hit.
There are three levels of special strikes.

[b]Super Smash[/b]

[list]
[*] Bad : the ball leaves at 150% of its normal speed
[*] Good :the ball leaves at 200% of its normal speed
[*] Perfect : the ball leaves at 300% of its normal speed
[/list]

[b]Drifting Ball[/b]

[list]
[*] Bad : the ball takes a 15° turn towards the inside of the table
[*] Good : the ball takes a 30° turn towards the inside of the table
[*] Perfect : the ball takes a 30° turn towards the inside of the table
[/list]

[b]Cloning Ball[/b]

[list]
[*] Bad : the bullet produces a clone
[*] Good : the bullet produces two clones
[*] Perfect : the bullet produces three clones
[/list]

[b]Gatling[/b]

[list]
[*] Bad : draws 10 clones
[*] Good : draws 20 clones
[*] Perfect : draws 30 clones
[/list]

[b]Fail Ball[/b]

[list]
[*] The ball turns into a chicken for four exchanges and it is impossible to throw other special strikes during this time.

It is triggered by too many bad skillshots.

After 2 bad skillshots, the next skillshot has a 25% chance of being a fail ball. 
If the skillshot passes the value increases by 25% to 100%.
[/list]

Don't forget to check your files, bugs may persist after the update.

If you need help or simply want to exchange with us, we give you an appointment on the Community Hub or on [url=https://discord.gg/iconik]Discord[/url].

- The Iconik Team

notes.title: KING PONG v0.19
notes.content:
[b][u]Headsets :[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Vive Cosmos support
[*] Windows Mixed Reality support
[/list]


[u][b]Gameplay :[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Cloning Ball update → the ball clones itself when it bounces on the table
[*] Player hands visibility correction
[*] Spectator mode added
[/list]


[b][u]UI :[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Friends invitation panel slightly reworked
[/list]

Currently, we are unable to correct the input problem for Virtual Desktop compatibility. Indeed, we use a recent VR tracking technology, OpenXR, which is not yet fully supported on Virtual Desktop. It is impossible for us to go on OpenVR at this stage of the project. We hope that an update or a more definitive and complete version of OpenXR will come out by the end of the early access. If not, we will put in place solutions to overcome this problem.

Don't forget to check your files, bugs may persist after the update.

If you need help or simply want to exchange with us, we give you an appointment on the Community Hub or on [url=https://discord.gg/iconik]Discord [/url].

- The Iconik Team
